recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. Do not add redundant Provenance prose under FHIR-7569; any future semantic changes to functional versus structural agent roles should be handled through the later role-clarity issue family or terminology governance rather than this DSTU1 tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-7569 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Security WG issue from DSTU1 asking to clarify the relationship among a Provenance activity, its agents, and the entities used in that activity. Its Jira resolution says the issue was resolved in FHIR-8595.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-7569. The related 2015 Security WG commit 1ca8cc96 added Provenance introduction text defining Target, Entity, Agent, and Activity and stating that a Provenance resource corresponds to a single activity with target resources, used entities, and associated agents. Follow-up commit 102e7011 corrected the FHIR-8595 vocabulary placement by moving assembler/composer into the Provenance agent-role value set.
additional_context: Provenance is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Provenance.agent.type describes functional participation in the activity and is bound to participation-role-type, Provenance.agent.role describes structural/security roles and is bound to security-role-type-example, and Provenance.entity.role describes how an entity was used in the activity. Later Published issues FHIR-32453, FHIR-32519, and FHIR-32520 refined this role split, and FHIR-8595 plus FHIR-32453 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already conveys the relationship clarification requested by FHIR-7569 through the Provenance introduction and the current agent.type, agent.role, entity, and entity.role definitions.
